fields.label: Recipients per broadcast (default)
fields.description: Used when a broadcast does not set its own cap. 0 = no limit. Leave blank to use the default (1000).

fields.label: Recipients per broadcast (highest allowed)
fields.description: No broadcast may ask for more than this. 0 = no limit. Leave blank to use the default (10000).

fields.label: Stored rows per broadcast
fields.description: Includes skipped contacts. Leave blank to use the default (50000).

fields.label: Recipients per request
fields.description: How many recipients one add call accepts. Leave blank to use the default (10000).

fields.label: CSV size
fields.description: Largest CSV text accepted in one request. Leave blank to use the default (2).

fields.label: Shortest phone number
fields.description: Numbers with fewer digits are rejected as invalid. Leave blank to use the default (8).

fields.label: Default sending speed
fields.description: Used when a broadcast sets no speed. Leave blank to use the default (20).

fields.label: Speed cap
fields.description: Meta's default throughput is 80/s. When Meta reports a rate it is used unless you set a lower cap here. Leave blank to use the default (80).

fields.label: First batch size
fields.description: Sending starts small, then doubles each chunk. Leave blank to use the default (20).

fields.label: Largest batch
fields.description: Upper bound for one chunk. Leave blank to use the default (200).

fields.label: Attempts per recipient
fields.description: After this many tries a recipient is marked failed. Leave blank to use the default (5).

fields.label: Wait after an access-token error
fields.description: The recipient is retried after this delay. Leave blank to use the default (300).

fields.label: Wait when the gateway is down
fields.description: The recipient is retried after this delay. Leave blank to use the default (300).

fields.label: Slow down when Meta holds messages
fields.description: Cuts speed to a quarter while many messages are held for quality assessment. Leave blank to use the default (True).

fields.label: Held-message ratio that slows sending
fields.description: Share of recent sends held by Meta before sending slows. Leave blank to use the default (0.3).

fields.label: Held-message window
fields.description: How many recent sends are examined. Leave blank to use the default (50).

fields.label: Minimum sample before slowing
fields.description: Avoids slowing on one held message out of two. Leave blank to use the default (10).

fields.label: One running broadcast per gateway
fields.description: Only one broadcast sends from a gateway at a time. Leave blank to use the default (True).

fields.label: Type the recipient count to start
fields.description: The start step asks for the queued count (callers using API keys skip the typing). Leave blank to use the default (True).

fields.label: Require consent confirmation
fields.description: Meta requires opt-in for business-initiated messages; this box is Huf's record of it. Leave blank to use the default (True).

fields.label: Create broadcast
fields.description: Requests allowed per minute for this action, per caller address. Leave blank to use the default (60).
